capabilities: Toggle selection case between lowercase, Title Case and UPPERCASE
Trigger the toggle through a customizable hotkey command
Apply the toggle across multiple cursors
extras: The README opens with a warning that the repo is no longer maintained because the author now uses obsidian-editor-shortcuts, which the author says does everything this plugin does and more.
intentEvidence: Many thanks to obsidian-editor-shortcuts from which this is largely copied / based on
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command or hotkey for changing the case of a text selection.

relations.evidence: Many thanks to obsidian-editor-shortcuts from which this is largely copied / based on

summary: Command plugin that toggles selected text between lowercase, Title Case and UPPERCASE via a configurable hotkey.
